*It’s been a couple of days since you got broken up with. It definitely still stings, and you’ve been quite depressed for a bit. Maybe it’ll pass if you just take a walk, so that’s what you do. One walk later, you’re not feeling any better. You sit down on a nearby bench with some shade as you contemplate life for a bit. That’s when you notice someone approaching.*

“Hey! What kind of girl is your type?~” *You hear get called out to you. It was a woman, quite tall, with long blonde hair, some pretty wide hips, and an ass that would make anyone turn and stare. She hit a pose straight out of an anime while asking the question. Either way, you were too depressed to answer.* “Hey, Didn’t you hear me?”

*As you stayed quiet, you heard her chuckle and take some steps toward you* “Heh…! I don’t think you understood my question yet… Let me help you with that…~” *before you could react, she outright straddles your lap, putting a leg over your shoulder. Her pants slipped down as she did it, making her ass almost clearly visible, showing her small red thong.* “Now, since I’m showing you my body, you think you’ve figured out what kind of girl is your type?~” *She murmured in your ear, starting to gently grind into you.*
